name: Risograph and halftone print
look: 2 to 3 spot inks on cream paper, off-register, grain, dot screens, overprint multiply.

fits.notes: indie, design, creative, community, editorial products

products: products needing exact brand colours beyond 3 inks

when_not: Avoid when colours must be exact brand (limit to 3 inks anyway).

type.guidance: Bricolage, Cooper, GT Sectra, Space Grotesk
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: Bricolage, Cooper, GT Sectra, Space Grotesk; fluorescent pink, blue, yellow, green on cream.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is ink A; ink B is a supporting hue; paper is cream
brand_lock.type_role: Bricolage / Cooper / Space Grotesk class for display, brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: plate-by-plate reveal on cream paper with registration wobble
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: two-ink print with off-register; ink A is the brand colour

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: two-colour separation illustration of {subject}: spot colour layers, black plate separate, cream paper, grain
codex_assets.r1_note: 2-colour-separation illustrations (ask "spot colour layers, black plate separate"), grain textures; A5 boil.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `styles/riso.md`, `halftone-dossier.md`, `systems/material/risograph-print.md`, `movements/risograph-culture.md`. Canvas halftone: sample luminance on a rotated grid, draw circles; `mix-blend-mode: multiply`; SVG `feTurbulence` grain; GSAP offsets per plate.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Pink and blue
palettes.words: cream stock, riso blue ink, fluorescent pink ink, yellow ink

palettes.name: Teal and orange
palettes.words: uncoated cream, teal ink, bright orange ink, black

palettes.name: Green and red
palettes.words: bone stock, forest green ink, warm red ink, sun yellow

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour replaces ink A (one of the 2-3 inks). The second ink stays style-fixed so the overprint still mixes; paper is style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Display in ink A, overprinted with ink B misregistered 5 px.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Serif for the editorial riso poster look.

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: poster grid 12-col with a 4% margin; shapes in ink A and ink B overlap into a third colour
composition.product_ui: UI printed as a 2-ink halftone plate is fine in stills; keep the real capture crisp in the proof beat on a paper 'insert' card

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: flat scan of a printed sheet, no perspective, even light. Lighting: flat scanner light; ink density varies slightly, paper white shows through. Material: two to three overprinted soy inks on uncoated cream stock. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: grainy ink coverage, halftone gradients, 1-5 px misregistration, paper fibre. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no gradients smoother than halftone, no black-and-white photos, no four-colour print, no glossy effects, no more than 3 inks.
codex.camera: flat scan of a printed sheet, no perspective, even light
codex.lighting: flat scanner light; ink density varies slightly, paper white shows through
codex.material: two to three overprinted soy inks on uncoated cream stock
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: grainy ink coverage, halftone gradients, 1-5 px misregistration, paper fibre

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: two to three overprinted soy inks on uncoated cream stock; flat scan of a printed sheet; cream stock, riso blue ink, fluorescent pink ink, yellow ink.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.
